journey.name: onchain send rejected broadcast
journey.description: Verifies that a deterministic backend rejection never reaches Bitcoin Sent. Requires a funded wallet, a valid destination address, camera permission already resolved, and the LDK Node broadcast-result contract from synonymdev/ldk-node#112. Run scripts/reject-electrum-broadcast.js on the host and configure Bitkit to use tcp://127.0.0.1:61001 before starting the send.

actions.action: Verify the Bitkit wallet home screen is visible
Type the valid regtest destination address into the recipient field (id "RecipientInput")
Verify the amount screen is visible (id "SendAmount")
Tap the 1 key (id "N1"), then the triple-zero key (id "N000"), to enter 1,000 sats
Verify the send review screen is visible
Swipe the confirm handle (id "GRAB") from left to right
Verify the transaction failure feedback is visible (id "SendFailure")
Verify the success screen is absent (id "SendSuccess")
Close the send sheet and open All Activity
Verify the rejected transaction is not listed as a sent on-chain activity
